$comment: Coldline Task 4.6 public answer contract. Four answers: a claim-review map from each claim id of docs/governance/ai-governance-analysis.md to one of the four classification values, applied in the order the sheet's comments state; one governance mapping naming a control id from the risk register and a concern id from docs/governance/concerns.md; the decision the decision policy gives for the completed register; and the register id of the one residual risk accepted for now. The public check validates this shape and that the sheet is not a copy of the sample; the protected answer check compares the four values after the submission on the platform. There is no self-attestation field, no pass boolean, and no recording URL.
title: Coldline Task 4.6 answers
description: The claim review, the governance mapping, the decision, and the accepted risk.

claim_id.description: A claim id as the supplied analysis numbers its claims: `CL-` and two digits.

control_id.description: A control id as docs/security/control-matrix.md lists them: `C-` and two digits.

concern_id.description: A concern id as docs/governance/concerns.md lists them: `GC-` and two digits.

register_id.description: A register id as docs/governance/risk-register.yaml lists them: `R-` and two digits.

answers.description: The only top-level answer mapping accepted by the public verifier.

claim_review.description: One entry per numbered claim of the supplied analysis, mapped to its classification.

governance_mapping.description: The one control from the risk register and the one concern it serves.

control.description: The control id, recorded in one register entry's `control` field.

decision.description: The outcome docs/governance/decision-policy.md gives for the completed register.

accepted_risk.description: The register id of the one residual risk accepted for now.
